q: What components make up the CSS Box Model?
explanation: The CSS Box Model consists of four parts: content, padding, border, and margin, starting from the innermost area to the outermost.

q: Which CSS property is used to control the outer space around an element?
explanation: Margin is used to create space around elements, outside of any defined borders.

q: HTML is a subset of ___________
explanation: HTML is a subset of SGML. SGML (Standard Generalized Markup Language) is a standard for specifying a document markup language or tag set.

q: Which property allows an image link to show a text label?
explanation: The alt property allows an image link to show a text label.

q: How is black color represented in terms of RGB values?
explanation: RCB(0, 0, 0) is equivalent to black color in terms of RGB values.

explanation: 1pixel is the default value for the BORDER attribute in HTML.

q: What does the Alpha value in RGBA represent?
explanation: A in RGBA represents the value of the Alpha Channel which is a measure of the Opacity of a color.

q: What does the Alpha value of 0.0 represent?
explanation: The Alpha value varies between 0.0 (fully transparent) to 1.0(fully opaque).

q: How does setting 'margin: auto;' affect an element?
explanation: Setting 'margin: auto;' on an element will center it within its containing block horizontally, assuming it has a specified width.
